vision: One source of truth for communication — from inquiry to alumni. Every team works from the same student record, every decision is informed by the same data, and every interaction is part of one connected communication strategy.

items.impact: Provides users with a consolidated view of important metrics, activities, and related records directly within Dynamics, allowing faster decision making. This increases engagement and enrollment likelihood.
callouts: Provides better visibility into key performance indicators

items.impact: Automates personalized communications throughout the admissions process, ensuring prospective students receive timely information without requiring manual outreach from admissions staff.
callouts: Improves applicant engagement through consistent touchpoints
Ensures every prospect receives the same quality experience

items.impact: Standardizes placement approvals through automated workflows, ensuring consistent review processes while reducing turnaround time.
callouts: Improves communication between Career Services staff

items.impact: Provides staff with a centralized workspace for employer or organizational account management, reducing navigation between multiple forms and related records.
Automatically introduces newly enrolled students to available student success resources, increasing awareness and encouraging early engagement by allowing the student to book time with their advisor
callouts: Improved student retention through early engagement

items.impact: Allows staff to perform mass updates and communications safely and efficiently, eliminating repetitive record-by-record processing.

Expands communication beyond email by incorporating SMS messaging into automated customer journeys, increasing engagement and response rates since text originating from journey will now go back to their assigned advisor vs a general pool.
callouts: Higher message open rates than email

items.impact: Delivers personalized surveys based on student information and journey stage, improving response quality while enabling actionable feedback.
callouts: Better data for institutional decision making

items.impact: Automatically validates phone numbers against the National Do Not Call Registry before outreach activities, ensuring regulatory compliance and reducing organizational risk.
Improves advisor efficiency by identifying viable leads for re-engagement, reducing time spent contacting unresponsive prospects while increasing recovered enrollment opportunities.
callouts: Recover "dead" leads that would have otherwise been lost.
Convert previously inactive prospects into enrolled students.
Re-establish communication with qualified prospective students.
Reduce advisor time spent calling unreachable or unresponsive leads.
Improve advisor productivity by prioritizing outreach to students most likely to respond.
Increase return on marketing and lead-generation investments by maximizing the value of existing leads.
Support enrollment growth without increasing staffing levels.

items.impact: Automates student career readiness, milestone completion, and advisor contact scoring within Dynamics 365. This provides Career Services with a unified view of each student’s progress, engagement level, and need for follow-up, allowing advisors to prioritize outreach and intervene earlier with students who may be falling behind.
callouts: Combines readiness, milestone, and contact activity into one measurable student success framework.
Reduces manual tracking and score calculation.
Gives advisors a clear prioritization model for student follow-up.
Improves visibility into student engagement and career preparation.
Supports earlier intervention for students who have low readiness, incomplete milestones, or limited recent contact.
Improves reporting for leadership and Career Services performance tracking.

items.impact: Provides a modern, scalable event management framework that improves the attendee experience today while reducing implementation effort for future event initiatives.
callouts: Improved event check-in efficiency and attendance tracking.
Established reusable event infrastructure within Dynamics 365 Marketing.
Created a scalable foundation for future recruitment, admissions, and student events.

items.impact: Automates benefit management for complex account structures, saving administrative time while improving consistency and scalability.
callouts: Eliminates repetitive benefit assignments across large account hierarchies.
Reduces manual administration for organizations with dozens of child accounts.
Preserves user control through configurable inheritance and exception handling.
Reduces data maintenance and user error.

items.impact: Implemented governance controls to prevent excessive Dataverse storage growth by restricting unsupported large email attachments, introducing automated storage remediation, and directing users toward more appropriate communication channels for mass communications. Reduces operational risk and long-term licensing costs by preventing unnecessary Dataverse storage consumption while establishing sustainable governance practices.
callouts: Encourages use of Dynamics 365 Marketing for large communications.
Introduces proactive governance to prevent future incidents.
Automates remediation of high-storage email records where appropriate.

items.impact: Transforms dashboard development from a custom-build process into a configurable platform, significantly reducing future implementation time while improving consistency, maintainability, and scalability of reporting across the enterprise.
callouts: Eliminates the need to build custom dashboards for each department.
Enables administrators to configure dashboards through a guided wizard rather than code changes.
Provides role-based dashboard experiences tailored to business functions.
Standardizes KPI calculations and reporting across departments.
Reduces development effort for future dashboard requests.
Creates a reusable framework that supports continued organizational growth.
Improves leadership visibility into operational and performance metrics.
